## Workload

Tomas Brennan completed 989 reads during the review period, recording 472 hours of work. This represents 2.1 reads per hour. The workload record provides a clear basis for assessing activity across the period and supports comparison between the number of reads completed and the time recorded. The figures should be considered together when reviewing the grader’s overall performance and work pattern.

## Quality

A total of 90 reads were checked as part of the quality review. The recorded agreement was 55.6. Priya Anand completed the review and considered the checked sample in assessing the consistency of the grading decisions. The result provides a measure of alignment between the original reads and the subsequent review. It should be retained with the workload information so that activity and quality are considered together. Any further discussion of the result should refer to the checked sample and the recorded agreement rather than workload alone.

Reviewer: Priya Anand
